title: Products and what arrives in a delivery
summary: Products in Supermarket Simulator are individual goods with their own id and their own texture: you order them, they arrive as stock, and some of them cannot be ordered until the shop has grown.
body: A product is a specific good rather than a generic box: the game keeps a product id and its own artwork for each one, which is why the same item always looks the same on the shelf and in your hand.
Products are gated by progress. Each product can carry a required store level, so a delivery list grows as the shop grows instead of being fixed from day one.
Stock is what feeds the shelves: a product only sells while it is physically on a shelf, and an empty slot is what the game refills.
What this entry does not tell you: prices, order sizes, delivery times or profit margins. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Every product is identified by its own product id.
A product can require a minimum store level before it can be ordered.
Products are placed onto shelves, and an empty slot is what triggers a refill.
The game runs a restock loop over products.
The build names an ice-cream bucket and the barcode lines used on product packaging.
Deliveries are run by a manager of their own, and how orders spawn is a setting kept apart from the delivery itself.
A delivery can be collected with a vehicle the game calls for.
The build ships several named toilet-paper products, including a bidet variety.
The product side names an indicator location and a product point, a content list for products, and a weighted text container for goods sold by weight.
facts.evidence: asset names: ProductIndicatorLocation, ProductPoint, Products List Content, WeightedProductTextContainer

facts.claim: Ice cream cones are products of their own, three of them.
Ordering and counting goods are named actions in the build: an order-goods entry, an increase and a decrease button, and looking for a product, with sounds for scanning and placing.
facts.evidence: asset names: Order Goods, Increase Product Amount Button, Decrease Product Amount Button, LookForProduct, Scanning Product, Placing Products SFX

facts.claim: The build also names goods by their material: an alcohol, a bleach and a baby-care line among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: M_Alcohol, M_Bleach, M_Baby_Care, M_Baby_Stuff
